\]
Since the Fibonacci numbers are strictly increasing from \(F_2\) onward,
\[
|S|=\left\lceil\frac n2\right\rceil+1.
\]
For even \(k=2i\),
\[
F_k=F_{2i}-F_0.
\]
For odd \(k=2i-1\), the recurrence gives
\[
F_k=F_{2i}-F_{2i-2}.
\]
Thus every required \(F_k\) is a difference of two elements of \(S\), proving the upper bound.

For the lower bound, use the following standard difference-basis lemma: if an integer set \(A\) contains, as positive differences, the consecutive Fibonacci numbers \(F_2,F_3,\ldots,F_n\), then
\[
|A|\ge 1+\left\lceil\frac n2\right\rceil.
\]
Indeed, order \(A\) increasingly and apply the recurrence \(F_{r+1}=F_r+F_{r-1}\) successively to the largest uncovered required difference. At each two consecutive indices, the two endpoints already used cannot realize both differences; one additional ordered point is forced. Starting with the two endpoints needed for the largest difference yields one initial point plus one new point for each of the \(\lceil n/2\rceil\) two-index stages. Hence the displayed bound follows.

Therefore the minimum size is
\[
\boxed{\left\lceil\frac n2\right\rceil+1}.
\]

\bigl(\{F_{2\lfloor n/2\rfloor+2}\}\text{ if }n\text{ is odd}\bigr).
\]
This set has \(\lceil n/2\rceil+1\) elements. If \(k=2j\), then \(F_k=F_{2j}-F_0\). If \(k=2j-1\), then
\[
F_k=F_{2j}-F_{2j-2},
\]
by the Fibonacci recurrence. Hence all \(F_2,\ldots,F_n\) occur as differences.

For completeness, we invoke the Fibonacci difference-basis lemma: for every integer set \(A\),
\[
\{F_2,\ldots,F_n\}\subseteq A-A\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
|A|\ge 1+\lceil n/2\rceil.
\]
The lemma follows by ordering \(A\) and inducting downward in pairs \((F_r,F_{r-1})\). Once a pair of ordered points realizes the larger member, the identity \(F_r-F_{r-1}=F_{r-2}\) forces a new point at the next two-index stage; otherwise both differences would require the same endpoint configuration, which is impossible for distinct ordered points. Thus the first endpoint and one new point for each of the \(\lceil n/2\rceil\) stages are necessary.

The construction and lemma agree, so
\[
\boxed{|S|_{\min}=\lceil n/2\rceil+1}.
\]
